title: Align styling in Document Report Experience themes, HF designs and bodies
summary: Styling of Word report themes, header/footer designs and bodies is aligned so they work consistently together, with tighter table spacing, updated font sizes, and removal of unused styles.
key_points: 17 binary Word files updated: 3 themes (Calm, Default, Playful), 11 header/footer designs, and 3 report bodies
Table styles now use consistent spacing (120/60), tabular numbers, and themes no longer embed header/footer parts
Normal style in header/footer designs changed from 8pt to 12pt, while body text follows theme styles instead of hard-coding size
External header/footer designs no longer include runtime dates; InternalModern uses Word DATE field for current date
Report bodies gain 3 to 5 new HideTableRowIfEmpty controls to prevent empty table rows
